subject: Runway guardrails — commit gates & quick forecast asks
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-08T16:12:00Z
Subject: Runway guardrails — commit gates & quick forecast asks

Folks — quick ask from Finance as we close Q4 planning. We ran the updated runway model and we’re seeing a narrower cushion than last month unless a set of mid‑quarter commits land as expected. To avoid last‑minute top‑down cuts, we need a prioritized, machine‑readable list of commit candidates from AE teams by EOD Oct 9.

What we need (for the top 10 active deals linked in HubSpot):
- HubSpot deal id (link)
- Committed amount (USD) / best case amount
- Current close date (if moved, highlight)
- Probability you are treating as "commit" (50/70/90)
- Critical gating items outstanding (legal/PO/procurement/technical)
- Next step owner + expected date

Attachment: runway_model_v2.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet)
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/19842, https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AbCdEfGhIJkLmNoPqRstuVWxyz/edit#gid=0

Can Priya/Ben own a quick pass and return the CSV (q4_commit_register.csv) with those fields filled for your books? Marcus will reconcile and flag true coverage shortfalls. If any deal needs an escalation — flag it in the sheet and tag Laura for approvals.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, FP&A
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-08T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Runway guardrails — commit gates & quick forecast asks

Thanks Marcus — got it. I’ll take the initial pass for my book and will pull Ben in for the mid‑market deals.

I attached a starter file (q4_commit_register.csv) with columns matching your ask and pre‑populated rows for the ten deals I own in HubSpot. I also created a shared sheet so we can iterate in real time: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AbCdEfGhIJkLmNoPqRstuVWxyz/edit#gid=0

Proposed process:
- Priya/Ben fill required fields in the CSV + add a single line "reliability note" when a deal's close date is not firm
- Marcus reconciles and returns a short list of 0–3 deals requiring escalation for Laura to approve credits/contingencies
- If any legal/PO items are outstanding, loop contracts (CC LegalOps) and tag Sarah (customer contact) for procurement timing

I can run a 20‑minute sync tomorrow (Oct 9) at 10:00 AM PT to review the top 5 deals. Ben — does that time work for you?

Attachment: q4_commit_register.csv (CSV stub)

—Priya
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Mid‑Market
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-09T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Runway guardrails — commit gates & quick forecast asks

Great outline — two operational clarifications from Sales ops side: please enforce the commit gates before we mark anything as "finance‑commit" in the model. My recommended gates (minimum 3 of 4 must be true):
1) Exec sponsor verbal + timestamped note in HubSpot
2) Procurement/Legal cadence scheduled or PO draft in flight
3) Technical POC (if applicable) complete or integration plan agreed
4) Customer budget signoff (email or PO)

Operational asks for Priya:
- For each deal, add a short justification line when probability >70% (one sentence)
- Add an "owner escalate" column (who to ping internally if coverage is at risk)
- Mark deals with cross‑region billing or sensitive data needs (I’ll need to route to Platform for private deployment checks)

I’ll join the 10:00 AM PT sync and bring a short slide that maps these gates to the finance model so Marcus can see the immediate run‑rate impact.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
VP Sales, Mid‑Market
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Cole <sarah@solstice-analytics.com>, LegalOps <contracts@solstice-analytics.com>
Date: 2025-10-10T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Runway guardrails — commit gates & quick forecast asks

Quick status update after the sync and the pass on the sheet:
- I filled the CSV for my ten deals (see attached q4_commit_register.csv) and updated the shared sheet. Top changes: two deals pushed 30 days; one deal moved to "best case" only (prob 40%).
- Marked three deals as meeting Ben's commit gates and flagged one deal for legal/PO follow up (tagged LegalOps).
- HubSpot links and short justification lines added for each >70% deal.

External touch: I looped Sarah at Solstice to confirm procurement timeline — she replied and confirmed draft PO expected by Oct 22 (see quoted inbound below). I added that note to the sheet.

Attachments: q4_commit_register.csv, commit_gates_template.md
Updated sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AbCdEfGhIJkLmNoPqRstuVWxyz/edit#gid=0

Next steps: Marcus to reconcile by EOD Oct 10 and publish the adjusted runway. Laura — if Marcus flags any escalation candidates, please confirm whether to approve mid‑quarter contingencies by noon Oct 11.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Mid‑Market
Redwood Inference
